auxiliary_raw_evidence_draft.base_sql:
SELECT 
    T2.Website,
    T1.`School Name`
FROM frpm AS T1
INNER JOIN SchoolContact AS T2
    ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T1.`Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` BETWEEN 1900 AND 2000

prefetched_grounding.provenance: deterministic read-only database probes; no model-authored claims

react.raw_react_sql:
SELECT T1.Website, T2."School Name"
FROM SchoolContact AS T1
INNER JOIN frpm AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T2."Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)" BETWEEN 1900 AND 2000
